_about: Words built into the app that speak as Zzzap Official. Every one goes through Say It Like Zzzap (Stacy 2026-11-15). Claude keeps this list current: a new built-in Official line is added here in the same change, with what it should say in plain words. "current" is what the app ships (picked 11/15). Picks come back to Claude as a file (Save for Claude).

groups.name: Ladder cards
groups.where: Home, one card at a time (NotesLadder.swift)

items.label: 1. Send your first zzzap
items.plain: Encourage them to send their first zzzap: ask their people something small, like where to eat or which shoes, and let them vote.

current.title: Tacos or pizza? Ask your crew.
current.body: Your first zzzap can be tiny. Where to eat, which shoes. Write the choices and let your people vote.

items.label: 2. Bring in 3 people
items.plain: Encourage them to invite people they ask for advice. Zzzap works best once 3 of their people are on it. The title is a live count like "1 of 3 people connected" and stays as is; only the text and the button come from this pick.
items.buttonFor: a page for inviting people by text

current.title: 1 of 3 people connected
current.body: Think of the people you already ask for advice. Zzzap works best once 3 of them are on it. Who's first?

items.label: 3. Vote from the Lock Screen
items.plain: Show them they can vote on a zzzap right from the notification without opening the app: long-press the notification and tap an answer.

current.title: Answer right from the notification
current.body: When a zzzap comes in, long-press the notification and tap an answer. That's your vote, no need to open the app.

items.label: 4. Make a circle
items.plain: Suggest making a circle, like Family or Work, so they can send to all of those people in one tap.

current.title: Your people, one tap away
current.body: Make a circle for Family, Work, or whoever you ask most, and send your next zzzap to all of them at once.

items.label: 5. Try a Storm
items.plain: Suggest trying a Storm: an open question where their people write in the answers and the matching ones stack up.
items.buttonFor: the New tab set to Storm

current.title: Out of ideas? Borrow your crew's.
current.body: Send a Storm and let your people write in their own answers. Matching ones stack up on the board, so you can see where everyone lands.

items.label: 6. Add a photo
items.plain: Suggest a photo zzzap, where each answer choice is a photo, for things like which couch or which outfit. Only shown to people who have Power or their free try left; for free-try people the app adds "Your first one's on us." after the text.
items.buttonFor: the New tab with photo choices on

current.title: Which couch? Let your crew decide
current.body: Snap the ones you're stuck between and make each choice a photo. Your people pick, you get your evening back.

groups.name: Watch How screen
groups.where: Opens from the Lock Screen card's button: a looping video of a Lock Screen vote (LockScreenVoteSheet in NotesLadder.swift)

items.label: Title and the line under the video
items.plain: A short title for a screen that plays a looping video of someone voting from a zzzap notification, and one short line under the video telling them how: long-press the notification, then tap an answer. The title shows at the top of the screen, so keep it very short.
